runtime_protocol.selection: Each of4 rounds reranks under selected preceding combination. Compare2 joint batches: top3V/top5L versus swapping their last-ranked member for next. Rank by new training errors vs original parent, new Other tokens, then mean signed correct-direction margin, then proxy damage; deterministic tie by arm index. No reserved-cal selection.

No prompt or factor search. Failed aggressive target preserved; no automatic training, board run, or further search.

first_phase.method: Teacher target cache, one retained block at a time on8GB GPU; original-index boundary mapping. Train attention+MLP LoRA, then evaluate composed student. This local phase is not full end-to-end joint QAT.

quantization: First FP32/BF16 adapter recovery baseline; merge to dense, export original per-module W2/W3/W4 G64/FP16-scale format with original orientation policy. No automatic higher bit width; quantify export loss separately before deciding QAT.
board_policy: No board actions in capture/training. New speed-only candidates may finish and save wrong answers; final demo promotion still requires all fixed windows correct and measured TTFT<30. Hardware fail-closed gates unchanged.
